verdict.rationale: Community reports describe LiveKit as a modern, self-run SFU built on Pion ion-sfu, so media routing through a selective forwarding unit is supported by independent evidence. No first-party documentation in the pack describes the SFU architecture, and nothing shows that each participant receives only the tracks it subscribes to. Missing for 10: first-party SFU/media-routing docs, evidence of per-participant selective track subscription and forwarding, relay/TURN routing details.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to

citations.quote: They called it the right choice for a modern SFU you run yourself.
Also liked that it builds on the well-reputed, battle-hardened Pion ion-sfu.
